title: Input cost bounded by conditional cost
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:(Fin ntoOmega)toalpha$. For a zero-error randomized decision tree $T$ computing $f$, an output value $ainalpha$, and an input $x$ satisfying $f(x)=a$, the expected number of queries on $x$ is at most the maximum of that expected query count over all inputs on which $f$ equals $a$, with the count taken to be zero on inputs producing another value.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a zero-error randomized decision tree computing $f$
